2003-06-26, 07:01
ThetaReactor
Moderator
  
Facedown in the shag rug.
Re: The One & Only [Or Else...] Thread for DXM
If you're conservative in separating the layers, it won't matter if the nonpolar solvent isn't completely clean. Sure, your yields will drop slightly, but it's a fair trade for the peace of mind that comes with a clean extraction.

Dichloromethane (methylene chloride) is also a very good nonpolar solvent. Of course, it's not necessarily pure in paint stripper form, and it's not the easiest thing to handle. Use gloves and good ventilation if you use it. You may be able to find it relatively pure from a photography chemical supplier.

Re: The One & Only [Or Else...] Thread for DXM
SuperPro:

quote:i weigh 245 and im 6'2 1/2 how much of the bottle should i drink? im looking to hit the 2nd level. Hopfully someone can lead me to some good cough syrup.

5mg/kg should land you somewhere in the second plateau. 245lbs = 110kg. Therefore, you need approximately 550mg DXM, right? Standard Max Strength syrups contain 15mg/tsp, or 3mg/mL. That comes out to about 185mL. It's fairly easy to find a measuring cup with mL markings, or you could measure out 37 teaspoons, I suppose. An 8oz bottle is about 240mL, so you'd need a bit over 3/4 of the bottle.

A list of some good OTC sources, and the shit to avoid: http://www.erowid.org/chemicals/dxm/dxm_info2.shtml (Stick to the ones that only contain DXM. I can personally vouch for the CVS brand Max Strength syrup.)

Re: The One & Only [Or Else...] Thread for DXM
Alcohol + DXM = Bad mojo, maybe some extra nausea, and a high likelyhood you make an ass of yourself.

Paxil + DXM = Holy serotonin syndrome, Batman! BAD IDEA. Same goes for any SSRI (Prozac, Zoloft, trycyclic antidepressants, etc.). In fact, pretty much any serotonergic drug could be nasty when mixed. That includes MDMA, meth, and possibly even tryptamines.

Weed is pretty much the only drug generally considered to mix well with DXM. Of course, there are some whackos out there that like to pop a couple dozen Benadryls, too. Fucktards.

{This was moved here by me. It was posted as a new thread and you know I can't allow that.}



quote:Originally posted by 10000_GeV:

Hello!

This will be very long: This is the first time I have fully considered the long-term effects of this drug, after a long period of judgment.

My history: I'm 18 now, and I used massive amounts of DXM when I was 14-15 for many days in a row.

I had done it during the summer after ninth grade a few times, but when tenth grade started was when I really got into it. I devised a simple way to skip as much school as I wanted (record my own voice, drop the pitch, pretend to be my own father with a very ill son-- one who wouldn't be at school until further notice. Call the main office once and hang up quickly. While the lady is busy at the phone, call back and leave the recording on the answering machine) and simply sat in my basement and tripped.

It was the perfect setting, because the basement was pitch black even during the day. I'd sit there for hours staring at CEV's and listening to Orbital/Autechre. Many times I hallucinated myself flying through outer space and exploring alternate realities. This would go on for eight dark hours until my father came home, shortly before which I would make my way to a friend's house.

My main method of use was coricidin, but when I couldn't get that I'd use Max.Strength Robitussin (which works better anyway). The most I ever took was 40-50 coricidin: I've forgotten now how many mg's that makes. All of this came from the local Safeway: the pants I would wear could hold more than enough coricidin, and the main effect of DXM, I've found, is the evaporation of all fear-- something no theif need have.

Anyway, the end of all this is that I eventually quit. I'm glad I did now, because I was basically a hallucinating corpse the whole time: I lost all of my friends, and didn't care. If you've read the introduction to Naked Lunch and remember Burroughs talking about "staring at his shoe for hours and hours," this is what I mean. I didn't have a life. This is not regret-- This is the truth.

But at the time I quit it was only because one night I decided to take more than I ever had: I must have taken 70 pills! I went out of consciousness and woke up. It was morning. My father and I had both woken up late. Now I suspect the school must have called him at work, because this isn't the type of person my father is-- though I can't be sure about this either. He said he would drive me to school, as I had missed the bus. The DXM was still with me from the night before, and it was as if I were dreaming. Once he noticed how out of it I was it was very easy to tell him all about the drug. He grew very angry. I decided I had fucked everything up so much that I should simply move out. So I moved in with my mother, ended up doing DXM several more times, and finally gave it up, fearful about the "brain lesions" talked about in widely available scientific literature pertaining to the drug.

My question is, has anyone else had a similar experience..? If so, I want to know something.

See, I've noticed very distinct long-term effects. These have been with me ever since I stopped using and I don't think they'll ever go away. It might surprise that this makes me very happy, because usually long-term effects from drugs are something negative.

These aren't.

I don't recommend DXM to anyone. Maybe I'd be in an even better state if I never used it at all. But I experienced a distinct spiritual opening after I stopped using. This is what happened:

1) All of the music I had ever listened to while on DXM gave me the most blissfull feelings imaginable-- not like DXM, but a simple shimmering feeling all over my skin accompanied by the instant evaporation of any worries or concerns I might be having.

The more worried or anxious I was, the easier it was to enter this state.

Because of this, I started to listen to these songs whenever I felt particularly bad.... I NEVER FAILED TO FEEL BETTER. Never once, ever.

I realized these songs were now powerful with respect to my own psychology. I also realized that the more I listened to them, the more accustomed I became, and the less relief I felt. Therefore I only listened to them on "special occasions," and developed a deep reverence for their power.

Today, that reverence remains. But more importantly, I noticed something else.

When this started happening: immediately afterward.

2) I noticed that any song, if enjoyed enough and listened to long enough, could grant this feeling.

Even today this happens. I bought a recording of Mass in B Minor only months ago and already it knocks me off my ass and into states of bliss.

I can never predict which music will give me this feeling. Often, the most beautiful music doesn't-- Scriabin rarely does, even though I regard his piano sonatas (especially when Ashkenazy plays them) above all else in terms of beauty. Thus, my musical tastes always follow the appearance of this feeling.

When this started happening: at most 6 months after I quit.

When this started happening very freely: 1-2 years after I quit.

3) I could transfer the feelings these songs gave me to any aspect of the world.

This wasn't completely intentional. I simply realized that my favorite poetry, my favorite book, my favorite aspect of nature, or my favorite thought could give this feeling if concentrated upon and at length. Even today I am surprised by what stimulates these feelings.

Last semester at college I came out of Organic Chemistry having failed the first test. My confidence was blown. I realized how cocky I had been about the class. All of my years of drug use had given me a fair amount of knowledge as to how to name compounds; confident that this was all that mattered, I didn't pay any attention to reaction mechanisms or electron flow. Hence my failure.

When I walked out of class, my mind was elsewhere, so I followed my feet to the beach. I don't know why I went, I simply did: when I got there I laid down in the sand and closed my eyes. It was freezing cold outside: this is Chicago in Februrary, folks.

Instantly the feeling hit me. It was stronger than ever before, and in seconds I realized that none of it mattered. I could become a failure at life: even that didn't matter. A simple Chemistry test was nothing!

I sat there for two hours in the sand. Anyone from the north will know that two hours in the February cold (especially with the wind off of Lake Michigan giving you frostbite) is not something to be taken lightly. Yet I felt none of it. I was lost in my own bliss.

The most important thing about this event was that a new idea started to form about this feeling. I could feel in my heart that it was definitely a "presence"-- that it wasn't just a feeling, but an outside consciousness.

I have no idea what that means.

When this started happening: 6 months ago

After the above mentioned event, my spiritual life blossomed. I felt a definite connection to something: every day I got closer to it.

Yet it fell away from me.

What happened? I started doing drugs again: The school I was going to was absolutely full of drugs: a haven for any kind of drug user. Every student deals at some point during the year. Coke goes through there like water. Alcohol is the air they breathe.

You might say, "Wait, where is this place again?" Well, I'm not going to tell. I'd like to see the drugs disappear, because it's turning from a very seriously academic place into a drug haven. Right now they are begging for students so anyone gets in.

To cut things short, after I started using drugs again I quit being able to control this feeling. The "presence" I spoke of left. To me that simply means I've got something better than drugs: I can have it whenever I want, it keeps me sane, and it goes with me wherever I go. After the drugs I'm back where I was 1-2 years ago, but to me that's a minor setback, and now that I've learned more about this feeling I'm sure I can be back where I was within months. One simply needs the right environment.

What I'm wondering is, Has anyone ever had an experience at all like this with DXM, or any other drug for that matter? I've got friends who used it at the same time as me--though not as much--and they've got nothing. Yet I know I'm not unique, and I've heard of this sort of thing before, of being "opened up" to higher realities by drugs, then ultimately abandoning them in favor of something much better. There were several books written about this sort of thing with reference to Hinduism, I believe.

But enough about me, how about you?

MY FIRST TIME on DXM, my little sucret(r).:

Found out yesterday that I didn't have to work today, so fuck I thought, I'll stay up late, then I thought "I'm gonna' get some cough syrup. Went to the drugstore, not a big selection of DXM only, not even robo-max, but I found sucrets(r) (4hr relief 15mg per losenge)! Dextromethorphan Hydrobromide as the only active ingredient. Chewed sucked and crunched away 30 of those cherry flavour things over the course of 1.5 hours, during that time I could feel it creeping up on me, then I thought, so this is cough syrup. In the last half hour, I went to the graveyard, I took 12 more (total 30) smoked a big joint and then, it's kickin' in, fuckin' mosquito's, start scratchin my hands, they feel hot and itchy, the mosquito's came and went, then as my friends (mosquitos) later, they would visit again. But holy crap, I'm in the graveyard late at night (a few days ago some older woman was walking her dog in the graveyard at about 9:30, she tells me I'm not to be there after 8:30, I say, It's after 8:30!?!?! Holy geez!!! As I rode by on my bicycle.)So last night here I was on cough drops, I'm hearing voices and don't need a tresspassing charge while on DXM for my 1st time. I'm trying to walk normaly when I thought, "so this is the robo-walk"! or so something I thought like this: Or at least "the sucret-walk, the sucret avenger" So I hide myself behind a pile of gravel next to a wooded area, I sat there and tripped my fucking balls off! I had intense visuals, like movies of images and patterns, I found it a lot like LSD, but, in a very different way? the gravel looked like tufts of 1 foot tall grass seed heads. Everything had a shiftyness to it, the buzz was heavy (as opposed to acid which is light), then when I thought when I was coming down it would sneak right back, and I'd trip hard again, in waves like LSD. Well I finally headed home and I thought I can't let her in on my little sucret (gf). So I went and sat in the car and listened to this black guy talk the blues about people he knew got killed, then classical music came on, and I fucking loved it, the complexity of the music (like Megadeth) created in my head visuals that were formed by the music. All the instuments created there own world in my head. Sitting in the car I could feel my self rotating in the car as if I could be just as well pointing at any other point on the compass other than my sitting position.

All in all, the experience was worth it, don't want to make it a habit, but may try it again. Today I feel a bit mushy in the head and a little unco-ordinated. I would like my brother to try it with me, and after that I'll stick with LSD or shrooms when I want to trip (if I can find the damn stuff!) I wanted to experience the 'Robo-walk' and I did, it's my dirty little Sucret(r)

Weight : 80kg+ - (approx 175 lbs)

Took : 30 losenges x 15mg = 450mg

Dose/kg: 5.625 mg/kg

browncloud
Regular
  
Canada
Re: The One & Only [Or Else...] Thread for DXM
Figure out your dose per kilogram of bodyweight (I did 5.6mg/kg yesterday for the first time on 4 hour relief sucrets, what a trip!) depending on the buzz you want. I weigh about 80kg : 80kg x 5.625mg = 450mg

Figure out how many mg's you want to consume: Read the recommended adult dosage on the label, find out how many mg's of DXM are in one normal adult dose. Find out how many mg's you want to consume, divide that by the mg in one dose, the answer is how many adult dosages you should take. For me it was 30 sucrets (or 30 adult doses) @ 15mg's (one adult dose) of DXM each = 450mg.

It's best to figure these things out on you own and get someone to check your math, you wouldn't want to go by a wrong answer!!! Geez, how long does this hangover last?!

Re: The One & Only [Or Else...] Thread for DXM
other than buying pure (well almost %99.9) DXM from chemical suppliers ive found that using "as generic as they get brands" for "lucidy's simple acid base extraction" (found on the dextroverse.org) seems to be the cheapist way to measure and do DXM.

all the following prices are from wal-marts in maine (im assuming they are the same all around the country but im not sure.)

1.Gallon size Equate (wal-mart brand) zip bags (25 in box... i think) $1.19 or there abouts

2.64 oz. Jug of equate amonia $0.99

3.plastic lemon $0.79

4.8 oz. bottle of ronsonol lighter fluid $2.49

Total Cost for about 6-8 extractions: $5.50

(you will need more lemon but everything else youll have plenty of leftover)

now for the actual DXM....

each 8 oz. (237ml) bottle of equate tussin dm has 2mg/ml SO.... 237 X 2 = 474mg per bottle. you will lose a little bit in the extraction so figure about 450mg per bottle. and these puppies are cheap. $2.67/ea

plus all the other materials are reusable so you can do alot more than one bottle with them if you hold on to them. if you need some off mg. count then use the little measuring cup that comes with the bottle... every 15 ml = 30mg. also, everything but maybe the lemon are usually readily available at any wal-mart (one stop shopping).

as a closing note to this probably lengthly post (trippin makes for a very talkative beLIEve-er) i would like to add that unless you dont plan on doing an extraction DO NOT USE TUSSIN DM. there is a shitload of guifesson in it and that would not be pleasant. trippin and shitting dont really mix well in my book. one last thing make sure you microwave (or cook on the stove if you like) your final product otherwise that taste will stick with you throught the whole expirence. hope this helped and didnt annoy.

I just did 630 mg of DXM in the form of sucrets friday night, this is my 2nd time. (1st 450mg)Although I did not want to do DXM twice in the same week, I could not wait to turn on my brother so he could tune in and cough drop out. He was apathetic at first about trying them but he was receptive to it. I told him that this is something that he has to try at least once in his life. After all he was worried about the brain damage, I told him that as long as it is not abused it's not bad at recreational dosages. So we ran out and bought 4 boxes of sucrets. I suggested I buy 2 boxes here and he buy two boxes where I first bought mine the first time so it wouldn't send up any red flags at the drugstore. My brother said "Fuck that, I'll just buy all 4 at once!" went back to my bro's place rolled some joints and consumed about 18 sucrets each in the span of an hour. I was getting pretty antsy to get our asses up to the graveyard before we took the rest of the sucrets and started to peak, It just seemed to take forever to get those joints rolled. So then we left and walked through the wooded area up the hill to the graveyard eating the rest of 18 sucrets each along the way, we went to a few different hidden locations smoking joints here and there, one of the spots were on this hill of gravel (same spot as my first trip) it was comfortable to sit on. Thats when it started to hit us (maybe it was at this point that I ate the rest of my sucrets left over from wednesday night). I told my brother to close his eyes, this makes everything seem more intense for sure! So he sits there with a stupid amazed grin! My brother is beginning to trust me that this was worth the 'not being able to drink beer situation' and that maybe this cough drop thing is worth it! And it hadn't even really started to hit him yet! So then we decided to head back after spending time in the graveyard so we could listen to the Beastie Boys and then Megadeth. On the way the world looked fuzzy with tracers and sound was coming from everywhere. It was sort of like an imaginary dream like world walking through the graveyard on through the trails in the woods that led down to the valley where my brother lives. Of course we did the Robo walk the whole way (earlier bro said that it looked like I had a pole shoved up my ass!) So we are at his place listening to the music and my brother is just amazed at all the visuals that are going through his head. Visions that I had, like movies and patterns. My visuals were not as great as my tolerance was up as I did DXM just 2 days ago. So we sat around enjoying the buzz until sometime after midnight or 1 O'clock or so. My brother said to me, "now I understand why you didn't want to buy all those sucrets at once, holy fuck man!" We started to come down, we were getting tired, my brother fell asleep and I went home. (my brothers first time dose was 540 mg's [36 sucrets]and he weigh's about the same as me, 80kg's)

PS, we didn't puke either, was it the weed, probably! My bro even has stomach problems (acid reflux or whatever, he took tums though).

I had a great 2 day lasting trip, starting the day before yesterday night. Me and my friend justin(his first time) took some gel caps( I took like 380mg, he took around 220mg.) We're both aroud 5'7'' 120 pounds. So we were dexing pretty good for a few hours, then like half way in to our peak, we decide to rummage his house for kinds of cough syrup and we found a few generic ass half bottles of stuff and downed em upping me to about 560mg total and him 330mg. Then we decide to chill in his room with his dog and some techno on(Sandstorm by Da rude). And like we're hangin off his top bunk bed and his dogs on the floor growling at us but the dex distorted my perception of size so the dog was huge. It was cool though. So anyway, at like 9 in the morning we were still a bit dexed but weren't that bad so we strolled a few blocks down to the local K-mart and picked up some of this 2 of these grape flavored childrens cough syrup that had only dex(7.5mg per teaspoon). We bought em seperate like 10 min between. and we poured these into some grape soda we grabbed from the vending machines and sipped it until we got back, and downed what was left. So when that kicked in we were dexing good as hell again. I estimate I had done... 900mg or so of it and him like 700 or 800? I was all dexed doing the math so its probably all off. Then we smoked a blunt in the later half of our peak. Then when we were coming down, almost completely I did a few rails of coke and smoked a blunt and a half a doob. The coke and doob made what was left of the dex come back, or at least felt like it.

I didn't have any really good visuals except peoples faces were getting oddly distorted, but I can't remember clearly. Oh, besides the dog. If we still got the packaging laying around I might get some more solid math.

quote:Originally posted by xSkrying:

Whats so bad bout ccc's

A box of CCCs has 64mg of CPM in it. The maximum dose you should have in a day is 24mg.

From EROWID.ORG:

High doses of Chlorpheniramine Maleate (CPM) can cause severe and life-threatening symptoms including seizures; shortness of breath or troubled breathing; weakness; loss of consciousness; severe dryness of mouth, nose, or throat; bleeding from skin, mouth, eyes, rectum, and vagina; and possibly death.

*Trip Report*

So exactly a week ago, almost to the hour, me and two other friends decided to Dex. I did 700mg(8 oz Robo) and they each did 5 1/2 oz each. We go back to my friends house and kinda sit in the dark. One friend is tripping his ass off, one didn't even feel it, and I was enjoying my nice buzz.

Me and my friend's brother decided to walk down to the beach which was somewhat far. About a mile. As soon as we both walked out, we both were thinking the same thing, its daytime! It was about 12:00pm but it seemed like day. It came on kinda slow for me. About half way there it was on, and I had a hard time walking. I felt like I was walking sideways, like, my legs were verticle but my torso was horizontal.

When we got to the beach, it was awesome. The water seemed like blue melted plastic, as if I could walk on it. For anyone who's ever seen the movie Contact, I thought I was on the beach where she met the alien. We get around to sitting down, its peaking. I get out my friends pipe and a dime of this kickass weed. I take about 5 hits and then this shit hits me. It was fucking insane. Vision completely cut up, can't walk, can't move. I could honestly say it was about a mile away from DXM. I've tripped really hard before on Dex with hullucinations/dissacocciation but it was about a mile away from anything.

Im a virgin to intense trips so thats why I'm rantting. I might do it again sometime. All we did after that is walked home. I blacked out a little where I don't remember how we got home part of the way. Oh, I wanna add something; Listening to the Doors on Dex is one of the incredible things in the world.

Re: The One & Only [Or Else...] Thread for DXM
I saw this method of making pills...

1 coffee filter

1 jar that has a smaller mouth than the coffee filters width

1 rubber band

1 12 inch x 12 inch sheet of tin foil

1 pot

2-3 cups of water ( in the pot )

1 knife

2 bags of Sucrets cough drops ( DXM is the only active ingredient)

2 tabs of Dramamine ( any motion sickness pills will due )

10 empty capsules.

(finding the right capsules to put this shit in is a pain

in the ass. I suggest you go to the local grocery store

and find the bottle of pills which use the largest

capsules. Empty the shit out of them, i used vitamin C

capsules.)

procedure:

Place the pot on the stove ( on high ), and let sit until the

water boils. Place all 40 of the cough drops in the boiling

water, and stir until disolved. When disolved, let the

mixture sit for 5 min. Now pour off the water on the top part

of the pot, this should leave a white sludgy powder at the

bottom ( with a little of red water). Dump the powder onto

the tin foil and place this in the sun to dry. Once this has

dried you should have a redish powder on the tin foil. scrape

this shit into a bowl. Now place the 2 tabs of dramamine in

the bowl and crunch em up & mix with the powder. Now you

should have a somewhat fine redish powder in your bowl. Now

all thats left is to take apart the capsules and put the DXM

into them. I recomend you take the eraser side of a pencil and

pack the DXM into the pills REAL tight. This should yield

about 6-9 pills.

Would it work?

This thread is humungous, but I'm going to make my little contribution to extend it even more.

SWIM tried going for the upper plateaus last night with great success. He weighs about 95 kg and took between 1g and 1.6g (no accurate scale) in two gelcaps, spaced out by about 10 minutes.

It was incredible, great fun, but a little scary as SWIM is by no means an accomplished psychonaut. He was trapped in the most wonderful mind loops that would keep bringing him back to reality and then send him flying off again. Looking at the computer screen (as he did briefly), the walls of his appartment became a misty forest whose end he could not see.

His mind was tripping out but he could still think rationally in a way, which he found very reassuring. Even so he felt a little fear at one point that he might have overdone it and a trip sitter would probably have been advisable.

Physical movement was nigh-on impossible. A friend was with him when he was coming up and interaction was fun and clumsy. When she had to go he just remembers seeing her waving at him from the other end of some wierd tunnel vision kind of effect. He crawled around his room ocassionally to do stuff but spent most of the time lying or sitting on his bed laughing to himself.

What a great trip!

Now is next day and head still feels a bit wobbly, and movement is still a little clumsy but head seems to still be on the right way.

BTW, I tripped on pure DXM powder.

EDIT: Also during his trip SWIM experienced contact and interaction with various entities - some of whom were visible (friends of his) and some who were just entities but whose voices, thoughts he could hear. They were all benevolent and harmonious in the mind trip. Sometimes they would tell me what was going to happen and it would happen. Quite amazing.

Re: The One & Only [Or Else...] Thread for DXM
Does anyone else find that they need way higher-than-usual doses of DXM just to get to the third plateau? I've only robo-tripped maybe a dozen times since I first tried it over two years ago, and I really love the experience. The very first time, I drank a 4oz. bottle of Robitussin Maximum Strength Cough (and I've stuck with that brand ever since) and had a definite first plateau experience. The second time, several weeks later, I experienced nothing at the same amount. So I tried 8oz. a couple days later, and the experience was almost exactly the same as the one before, except with some very minor (yet intriguing) CEVs. The next couple times I tried it, I stayed at that dose and had the same experience.

Then I didn't do it at all for about a year, and decided one day to try 8oz. again -- I felt absolutely nothing. Man, I was pissed. So about a week later, I tried 12oz. Nada. I pretty much gave up, until a few months later, when I decided to go for a full 16oz. Even then, from what I've read of others' reports, it couldn't have been more than a higher-level third plateau experience that I had. There were of course very noticeable tracers, and if I completely shielded my eyes from light for about 30 seconds then opened them suddenly, I'd get a wicked flanging effect. The CEVs were definitely more prominent than in previous experiences, but still not very strong; I've only ever had one major OEV on DXM, but quite a few smaller ones -- mostly having to do with looking at my hand and seeing a cigarette, then going to take a drag only to find nothing there. I'd also get completely absorbed in the visualizations on Windows Media Player and Winamp for hours at a time, lol. Other than that, not much to report, except the expected loss of depth-perception, slurring of speech, loss of any and all coordination, overall detached-from-reality feeling, and grossly misshapen pupils. I did have one experience that was quite strange, though... the only way I can describe it was as a waking dream. I was just lying in my bed, wide-awake with eyes open, and had a detailed delusion that involved me sitting at my computer desk working on my band's website. This seemed to last at least an hour, but then very abruptly, I came out of it and for the life of me, I couldn't figure out how I'd gotten from my computer to my bed in the blink of an eye, lol. I was so totally convinced that I had actually made the revisions to my website that I got up and checked. The site was, naturally, just the same as it had been before.

I've never been able to have just a first or second plateau experience since those first few times, and of course I wouldn't dare exceed the 1,422mg of DXM in 16oz. of Robo, as much as I would like to reach the fourth plateau.

At first I was thinking it may have something to do with a deficiency in the cytochrome P450-2D6 enzyme, as it's the metabolic pathway responsible for the transformation of DXM into DXO. But then I realized I've never had a problem with any other substrates of CYP2D6 -- the acid-test being codeine. If I were deficient in that enzyme, then my body would not convert codeine into morphine and thus would not have an effect on me. But believe me, it sure as hell does, lol.

For me, the peak of the experience lasts for about 16 hours, and the come-down is extremely slow... about 36 hours. So for the most part, I'd never dare do DXM on any day other than a Friday, because it takes all of Saturday and most of Sunday for me to regain my balance completely and stop slurring my speech. This doesn't seem to fit in with any reports I've read on DXM.

So, does anyone else experience similar problems?

2003-08-21, 04:30
Aedighe Duirmott
Regular
  
Re: The One & Only [Or Else...] Thread for DXM
quote:Originally posted by PopaChubby:

If the half life for dxm is 24 hours does that mean if you take 400 mg youd still be tripn a day later with 200 mg in you? or is that just not how it works



Not how it works -- "half-life" simply refers to how long it takes for half of the chemical in question to be eliminated from your body. For example, the half life of alprazolam (Xanax) is about 14 hours; so if you take a 2mg dose, even though the effects are long gone after 4-6 hours, there is still 1mg of drug left in your system after 14 hours. After 28 hours, there's 0.5mg left; 42 hours, there's 0.25mg left. So on and so forth.

Re: The One & Only [Or Else...] Thread for DXM
Salvia is one thing I really know, and mixing it with DXM right away is a **BAD** idea. If you are starting out with regular unfortified leaf, and are planning on smoking it, make sure you use a bong (filtration! it is filtered extremely well in water). If you aren't sure how to use it, just make sure you hold it in your lungs as long as can, 20-30 at least. If you are using fortified leaf, 5x for example, then be extra careful. Smoking one bowl of this is the same as 5 bowls of the normal stuff.

You will find that the state caused by Salvia is so immersive that using DXM would only hinder the experience. You might not experience results the first time, and it is important to continue trying, because when it does work, it will blow you away. On the other hand, it might work so well that it will scare you. Use as much caution as possible, and I would advise at least 4-5 good solid Salvia trips before mixing it with any other drugs.

Regular
  
Re: The One & Only [Or Else...] Thread for DXM
quote:

Nicotine seems to vastly potentiate DXM's effects for some people, enough so that one user reported that one cigarette could floor him on a second plateau trip. Another user reported that nicotine helped him overcome some of the memory problems with higher doses of DXM, but tended to induce nausea.

On the other hand, several people have told me that DXM should be avoided if one smokes cigarettes regularly (even if you don't smoke during the trip), because of nausea, hot flashes, and other unpleasant interactions. This might be due to inhibition of MAO by cigarettes (378,379) and if so, cigarettes should be avoided.



- THE DEXTROMETHORPHAN FAQ (http://www.erowid.org/chemicals/dxm/faq/dxm_faq.shtml)

holy shit! you posted the same question twice, that would be a "BLTC no no".

and im not telling you were to get this " puseada thing" because you cant spell it right... there's my logic.

but i can tell you what it is, and that its not a good idea to over dose on pseudoephedrine.

Pseudoephedrine is a decongestant. It works by shrinking blood vessels (veins and arteries) in the nose, lungs, and other mucus membranes. By decreasing blood flow to the nose, lungs, and other areas, pseudoephedrine decreases congestion, and airways are opened up.

it is used to treat congestion associated with allergies, hay fever, sinus irritation, the common cold...and whatnot...

the awesome part is when you OD on this stuff, kinda like when you drink 2 bottles of robo, with both pseudoephedrine and dextromethorphan, you are not only putting yourself at high risk of hallucinations(because thats what you are after all, right?) but, extreme tiredness, sweating, dizziness, a slow heartbeat, and coma yay!!

moral of the story is to stick with just plain dextromethorphan, not any of these combination meds.

the outcome probably wouldnt be what you are looking for anyway, the majority of people i have talked with and had have experiences with sudafed, all agree, its gotta be the second worst body high along with diphenhydramine and dimenhydranate at the OTC level..

but i dont know, im not your mother, so go kill yourself, but make sure you have fun doin it.

i dont feel like re-reading this, so sorry for any spelling errors.

Re: The One & Only [Or Else...] Thread for DXM
Someone mentioned something about Olney's lesions, and they seem to be worrying some users, so i thought i'd help to set the record straight.

Olney's lesions are a condition caused to the brain in which microscopic lesions form in the brain because of extended use of disassociatives. There has never been a documented case of Olney's lesions in humans. The only animal ever shown to exhibit them is the rat.

An essay written recently disproves and debunks most of the stigma behind the Olney's lesion theory. Find it here.

http://www.erowid.org/chemicals/dxm/dxm_health2.shtml

It also has some other useful information about disassociative use, so reading it would be beneficial to any health-conscious dxm user.

Re: The One & Only [Or Else...] Thread for DXM
quote:The serotonin syndrome is a hypersotonergic state which is a very dangerous and a potentially fatal side effect of serotonergic enhancing drugs which can have multiple psychiatric and non-psychiatric symptoms. It is a condition which has been on the rise since the 1960's when we began using more and more drugs which directly affect serotonin. This is a toxic condition which requires heightened clinical awareness in order to prevent, recognize, and treat the condition promptly. Promptness is vital because, as we just mentioned, the serotonin syndrome can be fatal and death from this side effect can come very rapidly. This syndrome is a toxic hyperserotonergic state whose rate of incidence is unknown, but is on the rise. The suspected cause of that increase is the introduction of the new selective serotonergic enhancing agents in clinical practice - the SSRIs. This disorder, brought on by excessive levels of serotonin, is difficult to distinguish from the neuroleptic malignant syndrome because the symptoms are so similar. The neuroleptic malignant syndrome is a serious condition brought on by the use of the neuroleptic drugs.

The symptoms of the serotonin syndrome are: euphoria, drowsiness, sustained rapid eye movement, overreaction of the reflexes, rapid muscle contraction and relaxation in the ankle causing abnormal movements of the foot, clumsiness, restlessness, feeling drunk and dizzy, muscle contraction and relaxation in the jaw, sweating, intoxication, muscle twitching, rigidity, high body temperature, mental status changes were frequent (including confusion and hypomania - a "happy drunk" state), shivering, diarrhea, loss of consciousness and death. (The Serotonin Syndrome, AM J PSYCHIATRY, June 1991)

"The serotonin syndrome is generally caused by a combination of two or more drugs, one of which is often a selective serotonergic medication. The drugs which we know most frequently contribute to this condition are the combining of MAOIs with Prozac (this should also include the other SSRIs) or other drugs that have a powerful effect upon serotonin, ie., clomipramine (Anafranil), trazadone (Deseryl), etc. The combination of lithium with these selective serotonergic agents has been implicated in enhancing the serotonin syndrome. The tricyclic antidepressants, lithium, MAOIs, SSRIs, ECT (electric shock treatment), tryptophan, and the serotonin agonists (fenfluramine) all enhance serotonin neurotransmission and can contribute to this syndrome. Anything which will raise the level of serotonin can bring on this hyperserotonergic condition. The optimal treatment for the serotonin syndrome is discontinuation of the offending medication or medications, offer supportive measures, and wait for the symptoms to resolve. If the offending medication is discontinued, the condition will often resolve on its own within a 24 hour period. If the medication is not discontinued the condition can progress rapidly to a more serious state and become fatal. It should be apparent that the greater the enhancement of serotonin levels, the greater the chances of producing the serotonin syndrome. Therefore it is recommended that Zoloft, Prozac, Paxil, Luvox, Serzone, etc. not be used concurrently with each other or any other serotonergic drugs and that these serious adverse reactions should be expected with these combinations

8 |_| |V| P

Guanifenesin (however it is spelled) causes much nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea. In a high dose, as with taken in a dxm trip, it would become quite unpleasant. Pseudoephedrine is really bad, though, because if you take a lot of it, it can cause respiratory depression, ie-you can't breathe, which of course, results in death. I don't know who told you that anything but DXM in your dose is okay, but it is generally said that if it contains anything other than DXM, don't use it. Just about every other ingredient they add will cause problems in such a high dose.

Re: The One & Only [Or Else...] Thread for DXM
In regard to the fact that someone mentioned tripping on DXM in school, I figured I might as well share what happened to me the other day.

I'd done it once before last year with a low dose and it was a lot of fun, so this time I decided to try more. I use pure powder which I make into capsules myself, but I don't really know how much each one contains, but all i know is, i took 2 pills, which would normally be an averagely-small dose.

I've figured out a different system for filling my capsules now though, and it allows me to get a lot more in. I didn't take that into account when I took those 2. I took em when I got school at about 7:30. At about 8:15 I could feel it kicking in, and as I left 1st period I was walking pretty fucked up.

By the middle of second period, about a half hour later, I was tripping harder than I really wanted to. I couldn't focus my eyes on my paper and maintaining a stable position in my chair was difficult. When the teacher looked at me it took all I had to keep myself from exiting the room and entering into my own dream world. The whole time I felt really paranoid that someone would be on to me and get pissed.

Luckily, they didn't, and the next class rolled around. Gym class! Wo0o. I was still tripping hard, but I didn't have any choice, so I went outside and played football. I couldn't catch the ball worth a damn, it was like the ball was like skipping frames of my vision. I threw the ball really well though, probably because it allowed me to relax more. After a half an hour of that, it had allowed my body to metabolize most of the shit and I was back down to an acceptable high. Woo. The next couple of hours were quite pleasant, the stuff of good dxm trips.

So a word of advice- If you're going to trip during school, don't take too much. It can be a very unpleasant experience.

Bump.

Okay...Here's a report for anyone that wants to read one. It won't be very detailed..just some feelings I had, some my friend had, and most likely a few questions. We both took 525mgs of just Dextromethorphan HBr(give or take 5mgs).

We stayed on the phone most of the time the experience lasted...It was much stronger than my first two times (180mgs and 360 mgs...both of which had the same effects as being drunk mixed with a great euphoria) this time everything was great...extreme euphoria, difficulty walking but what else can you expect? I listened to music with crappy headphones and an old CD player..the music sounded as though it was played live infront of me. The music and lyrics seemed to melt into my body...It was amazing. My friend was laying in his bed in all dark and he was feeling great...he had some vivid closed eye hallucinations, or so he says. The only negative effect I felt was the Itching...agh the itching..my back and neck mostly...some on my upper arms though. My friend also had the itch..but he had another problem...whenever I had to go to the bathroom or go get a drink or something he felt as though something he referred to as "They" were going to get him...he was scared out of his mind unless we were talking...very odd to me...if anyone has any input on that please get back to me.

That's all this time fellow dexing totse members...I look forward to replies.

- UntilTheEnd

*****TRIP REPORT**********

This happened wednesday by the way

A good friend (I'll call him K) went to walgreens with me and we picked up two 8oz bottles of robo max strength (one for each of us). We headed to this park that is mostly just a bunch of trees for a couple miles in each direction. We downed the robo, smoked a bowl, and walked to a gas station about a half mile away and i called a friend (C) that wanted to come see us while we were tripping. He came and brought his camera along. By the time he got there (about a half hour after calling him) we had walked back to the park and were waiting for him. WE (K and I) were starting to trip at this point so we walked through the woods with our friend doing various things. One thing in particular that was pretty funny was we raced after spinning in circles. I ran all the way to the "finish line" spinning in circles the whole way there and then fell down. After a couple hours of just messing around our friend (C) drove us to our other friends house (i'll call him R) who lived close by.

When we arrived at his house he instantly knew we were tripping and his other friend that was there knew too. We smoked a cig and watched a bit of TV (which i quickly gave up on). Soon after, we headed to his basement to smoke a bowl (or was it two?). We went back upstairs for another cig. As weird as it may sound i have major difficulties going UP stairs on DXM. I fell about 5 times on the seconds step up before realizing it would be easier just to climb up them on my hands and knees. After smoking the cig upstairs K and I went back to his basement and turned the lights off and started seeing crazy shit. I saw a computer terminal to enter a password into, which after turning on the lights, i realized it was a cardboard box with some random junk in it. I saw the usual crazy wierd morphing lines and shapes too. Also the entire room seemed to be morphing in wierd shapes. After tripping in his basement for what was probably 1 1/2 hours (R) had to go to work so we walked back to the park we were at before.

We wandered through the woods for a little bit and smoked another bowl about an hour later. Shortly after smoking that bowl i just layed down in the middle of the woods and layed there for about 45 minutes. I felt completely at peace and amazingly confortable, and my mind was completely clear of any thoughts whatsoever. It was one of the greatest feelings ive ever had (anything better would also be on DXM ). At this point we were starting to come down a little bit, although i still couldn't really feel my body. We then wandered in the middle of the woods for probably 1 1/2 more hours and then got into my car (i mentioned to my friend i still felt a little fucked up for driving) and met up with some friends.

This was one of five 700mg+ trips, and it was about average in intensity (ive had probably 15 trips that were less than 500mg). I seem to definately be in the 1/3 of people that does DXM more than once, in fact i'd say it is my favorite drug ive ever done. I think overall i enjoy DXM more than "real drugs" like coke, meth, shrooms, etc. The only downside for me with DXM is the amount of time a trip takes up, but if you have the whole day free, why not have a good experience? Sorry for my long winded trip report. No amount of words could describe a DXM trip (or most drugs for that fact) but i guess i made an effort.
